Maya Patel: Quick announcement: we're splitting eng-runtime into two focused squads: Model Serving (latency & SLOs) and Inference Tooling (developer tools, SDKs, eval infra). Lucas Park is joining as Director, Model Serving starting 2025-08-01 and will own the Serving squad. Diego will stay on as IC lead for Inference Tooling. We'll open two backfills: Senior Serve Eng and Senior Platform SWE. Please update org charts and join Lucas's intro AMA next Tues 09:30.

Lucas Park: Super excited to join Redwood. First order of business: shadow current oncall and run a 1:1 with leads the week of Aug 4. Happy to sync with any teams directly.

Diego Morales: Thanks Maya  I'll put together a short handoff note and freeze non-critical tooling changes for one sprint to stabilize.

Leah Kim: Recruiting note: approval to post both reqs tomorrow. New hiring ask: add a 2-week rotational apprenticeship for new hires to get paired with SRE and runtime for context. I'll attach the reqs + rubric.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Lucas intro + Serving AMA" Tue 09:30-10:00  attendees: all@company

Jon Park: Question: will product tickets be split by squad or remain centralized? We should avoid duplicate ownership of routing rules.

Maya Patel: Product tickets will be routed by domain: latency/regional routing to Model Serving; SDKs, eval infra, and quality tooling to Inference Tooling. We'll publish an ownership map by EOD Friday.

Anya Rao: For the apprenticeship, can we make a non-blocking checklist so hiring managers know expectations?

Leah Kim: Yep  will include a short apprenticeship checklist in the req thread. Target hire window is 5-7 weeks.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Welcome Lucas  post any handoff questions in this thread or bring them to the AMA.
